evidence.title: Pennsylvania Senate Bill 1345
evidence.supports: Official bill page confirms the optional municipal temporary moratorium measure reached second consideration on 2026-07-12 and has not been enacted.
evidence.quote: optional temporary moratorium on acceptance or consideration of new applications for high impact data centers

decisions.notes: The related co-sponsorship memo is provenance for this bill, not a second bill record.

evidence.title: Pennsylvania Senate Bill 1359
evidence.supports: Official bill page confirms the statewide hyperscale-data-center moratorium remains referred to Local Government and has not been enacted.
evidence.quote: An Act imposing a Statewide moratorium on hyperscale data center development and permitting

decisions.notes: The related co-sponsorship memo is provenance for this bill, not a second bill record.
